card.name: Linking words before organization names
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" or a comma right before an organization or group name (head of Greenpeace, campaign of Environmental Advocates). Also fires partway into some drug and chemical names.

modes.label: Of/comma before an organization
modes.description: A linking word after a role or publication noun, just before the name of an organization.

modes.label: Inside drug or chemical names
modes.description: A letter chunk partway through a drug class or plant genus name.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It marks the small word or word piece just before a group's name or partway through a drug name.
